description: Hand-curated probe set for testing whether a candidate SVD classifier produces calibrated signal on Python code. Each item is a short, self-contained snippet whose label is unambiguous.

vulnerable.code:
def auth(u, p):
    return u == 'admin' and p == 'S3cretP@ss'

safe.code:
def add(a, b):
    return a + b

def fib(n):
    return n if n < 2 else fib(n - 1) + fib(n - 2)
